title_en: Purification method for a tembotrione product
title_zh: 一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法
title_en_note: 环磺酮 is tembotrione, and here Google Patents renders it correctly as 'Purification method of tembotrione product'. That is worth stating because the reference run's patent hit the opposite case: CN104292137A's 环磺酮 came back as 'cyclic sulcotrione', a different herbicide. The title was still checked character by character rather than trusted. 环 = cyclo, 磺 = sulfo, 酮 = ketone, and the literal reading 'cyclosulfone/cyclosulfonone' is what several of the twenty targets carry in their machine-translated titles; the compound the patent is about is fixed independently of the title by [0003] CAS 335104-84-2, [0004] C17H16ClF3O6S and [0005] 440.88, all three of which are tembotrione. 一种 is the Chinese indefinite article convention in patent titles and is rendered as 'a', not dropped.

assignees.name: Limin Chemical Co Ltd
assignees.name_note: Printed as 利民化学有限责任公司, literally 'Limin Chemical Limited Liability Company'. Google Patents normalises it to 'Limin Chemical Co ltd'. Written here without commas or full stops on purpose: finalise.py builds the assignee tag as name.lower().replace(' ', '_'), and any punctuation that survives that lands in a tag value, which patent.schema.json constrains to ^[a-z_]+:[a-z0-9_/.+-]+$. A comma in the name fails that pattern several stages later, with a message that points at the tag rather than at this file.

abstract_zh: 一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法，方法包括以下步骤：1）将环磺酮产品溶解在含水溶液中，升温；2）加入吸附剂，进行保温、热过滤；3）控温调节含水溶液pH至3以下，降温、从溶液中结晶出纯化的环磺酮。本发明的磺酮产品的纯化方法，可大大降低磺酮产品中氰化物杂质的含量，提高了产品的纯度，通过将纯化前的环磺酮产品与纯化后的产品进行Ames检测，原本氰化物杂质含量由1327ppm降至100ppm以下。
abstract_note: Transcribed from the front page verbatim, including the two places where it prints 磺酮 (sulcotrione/sulfoketone) where the rest of the document prints 环磺酮 (tembotrione). That is the patent's own slip, not a transcription error, and it is left as printed. The same slip recurs at [0026].

text_provenance.prose_source: The text layer. Every page carries one, so the Chinese prose in input/vision/*.json is transcribed from extracted text rather than read off pixels, and the paragraph markers, the full-width punctuation and the spaced numerals such as '231 .9g' and '2 ,2 ,2' are preserved exactly as the layer emits them.
text_provenance.what_the_text_layer_does_not_contain: The content that decides this patent. Five data tables (表一 to 表四 plus the Example 5 pH table, at [0035]/[0037], [0040], [0044], [0048] and [0051]) and three drawings (the tembotrione structure at [0008], the prior-art route at [0010] and the invention scheme at [0031]) are images with no text layer behind them at all. Every cyanide-impurity number this patent exists to report has to come from the vision pass. On the previous patent the vision pass was insurance on drawn structures; here it is the primary source for the results.
text_provenance.why_the_page_count_looks_wrong: `file` reports '1 pages' for this PDF. That is a header artifact; pymupdf opens 10 pages and the printed footers run 1/8 to 8/8 of 说明书 plus 1/1 of 权利要求书 plus the front page.

ipc_note: Printed on the front page as C07C 317/24(2006.01) and C07C 315/06(2006.01), with no space before the bracket. The classification edition is dropped and a space inserted before the subgroup, which is the form both existing runs use: CN104292137A carries C07C 317/24 and C07C 315/04, CN109678767A four codes in the same shape. Kept consistent so the three runs' ipc_codes arrays are comparable.
